Deletes quarantined files older than --older-than. Use --dry-run to see what
would be removed.

See .zqk/process/system-health/QUARANTINE_AND_ANALYSIS.md for what goes in
quarantine.

Usage:
  zqk system cleanup-quarantine [flags]

Flags:
      --dry-run[=true|false]   Show what would be removed without deleting
      --older-than duration    Remove files older than this (default: 720h = 30 days) (default 720h0m0s)
      --verbose[=true|false]   Show each file removed or would be removed

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded[=true|false]   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
